feat\(genesis\): Complete GENESIS Destatis integration for German statistics

Implements comprehensive integration with German Federal Statistical Office \(Destatis\)
GENESIS database, enabling visualization of official German statistics in Superset.

## Features Added

### Backend
- Automated database connection setup with CLI command `superset init-genesis`
- Data freshness tracking with metadata table and migration
- REST API endpoints for search, metadata, and refresh operations
- Enhanced data loader with timestamp tracking and selective table loading
- Docker Compose profile for easy deployment

### Frontend
- React-based Table Browser UI at Data → GENESIS Data
- Search functionality for discovering GENESIS tables
- Color-coded freshness indicators \(green/blue/yellow/red\)
- Real-time data refresh capability
- Full TypeScript implementation with proper types

### API Endpoints
- GET /api/v1/genesis/metadata - List all tables with freshness info
- GET /api/v1/genesis/metadata/<code> - Get single table metadata
- GET /api/v1/genesis/search?q=<term> - Search GENESIS database
- POST /api/v1/genesis/refresh/<code> - Refresh table data

### Documentation
- Updated README with GENESIS section and quick start
- Enhanced integration guide with new features
- New end-user guide with tutorials and best practices

## Implementation Details

- 18 new files \(backend, frontend, documentation\)
- 4 modified files \(routes, initialization, loader, README\)
- ~3000 lines of code
- Full TypeScript with no any types
- Follows Superset design patterns and best practices
- Production-ready with error handling and logging

## Usage

docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose-genesis.yml --profile genesis up -d
docker compose exec superset superset init-genesis
docker compose run genesis-loader

Then navigate to Data → GENESIS Data in Superset UI.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
